· Position vs SMA100/200($88.48/$78.63): Strong long-term trend.
· 52-week position (75.4%) + Current price range in a decline from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (45.4→51.0): Exited oversold, entering neutral zone, weak directional bias.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.2102→-0.0849): Improving but still bearish, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $90.98): Bandwidth 7.90% narrowed, lacking direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($88.30): Based on Pivot S1($86.37) and SMA50($89.76).
· Swing Resistance ($93.69): Expecting upward momentum upon breaking R1($94.57).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Recovery signal, potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.80x): Low confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Entry at 90.71, stop at 88.30, target at 93.69.
